t: Six things he took shelter from
a: أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ وَالْجُبْنِ وَالْهَرَمِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ فِتْنَةِ الْمَحْيَا وَالْمَمَاتِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ
p: Aʿūdhu bika mina-l-ʿajzi wa-l-kasali wa-l-jubni wa-l-haram, wa aʿūdhu bika min fitnati-l-maḥyā wa-l-mamāt, wa aʿūdhu bika min ʿadhābi-l-qabr
m: I seek refuge in You from incapacity and laziness, from cowardice and decrepitude, and from the trial of living and of dying, and from the punishment of the grave.
